name: [UPD] Concrete Cleaning Simulator 💦
desc:
Take on cracked, stained concrete and bring it back to life.
Blast away dirt, grime, and years of buildup… then protect it with a smooth, professional seal coat.

🏢 Build and grow your own cleaning company — earn money even while you’re offline
🐶 Open eggs and hatch Prismatic Pets to help you clean faster and have your buddies sweep away all the stains
🍀 Lucky Blocks and Random Customer Events happen every single job, every single run will generate a new adventure
👥 Clean Together with friends for faster jobs and bonus rewards
🧼 Deep, satisfying concrete cleaning
💦 Pressure washing mechanics
🏗️ Outdoor spaces and heavy-duty surfaces to restore
🛡️ Finish every job with clean, fresh seal coating

It’s not about rushing… it’s about restoring every surface to perfection.
